description: Source code implementing SHA-256 cryptographic hash functions and related file processing, including a main function that computes a SHA-256 hash of a file and embeds it into a custom TLV format.

classes.name: sha256
classes.description: Structure representing the state of a SHA-256 hash computation.

methods.name: ror
methods.description: Performs a bitwise rotate right operation on a 32-bit integer.

methods.name: processblock
methods.description: Processes a 64-byte block of data for SHA-256 computation.

methods.name: pad
methods.description: Pads the message to meet SHA-256 block size requirements.

methods.name: sha256_sum
methods.description: Finalizes the SHA-256 hash and outputs the digest.

methods.name: sha256_update
methods.description: Updates the SHA-256 state with new data.

methods.name: write_tlv
methods.description: Writes a TLV (Type-Length-Value) record to a file.

methods.name: write_tlv_string
methods.description: Writes a TLV record with a string value to a file.
